task: Open PDF tools on your computer to merge, split and edit documents

x-display.title: Open a PDF toolbox
x-display.summary: Merge, split and edit PDFs in a browser app running on your computer.
x-display.description: Choose this when you want a collection of PDF tools you can use directly. Open Stirling-PDF, pick the operation you need and provide the documents in the app. The toolbox stays available for your next task.

packaging_note: Runs Stirling-PDF's unmodified official image, pinned to its release digest.

access.why: The local web page uses a container network that can reach the internet. Its address is published on loopback.

known_issues: No sign-in; anyone with access to the local page can use it. The first start downloads the upstream image.
licence: Upstream open-core licence; includes separately licensed proprietary components. Uses the unmodified upstream distribution.
